metadata.title: Print 8 — Professional Printing
metadata.description: Print 8 offers business cards, menus, invitations, t-shirt printing, cups, bags, and personalized gift sets.

home.heroTitle: Professional printing for your business and events
home.heroSubtitle: Business cards, invitations, menus, and custom products — prepared and printed with care. Choose a ready-made design, enter your details, and order online. Pay on delivery.
home.featuredServicesDesc: Professional printing for everyday business needs — cards, documents, menus, and more.
home.featuredDesignsDesc: Customize text and colors online, then order exactly what you see. Filter by category and explore our templates.
home.noDesignsInCategory: No personalized templates in this category yet.
home.contactCtaDesc: Reach out for help with designs, file formats, delivery, or a custom quote. We usually reply within one business day.
home.featuredProductsDesc: T-shirts, mugs, bags, and more — customize with your design or order as shown.
home.whyQualityDesc: We use professional equipment and materials for lasting results.
home.whyCustomDesc: From business cards to gift sets — every project is tailored to you.
home.whyDeliveryDesc: Order online, pay when you receive your product.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete printing solutions — from business cards to personalized gift sets.
services.designsSectionDesc: Choose a template and send us your details — we prepare the design for you.
services.productsSectionDesc: Pick a product and add your design, or order as shown.
services.orderHint: You can also place a general order for this service. Upload your files at checkout if needed.

business-cards.title: Business cards
business-cards.description: Professional business cards with high print quality, various materials and finishes.
business-cards.detail: Choose a ready-made business card design and send us your contact details. We prepare the layout and print for you.

restaurant-menus.title: Restaurant menus
restaurant-menus.description: Elegant menus for restaurants, cafés, and hotels — laminated or plastified.
restaurant-menus.detail: Browse menu templates and share your restaurant details. We format and print your menus.

laminating.title: Laminating
laminating.description: Protection and enhancement of documents, posters, and menus with professional laminating.
laminating.detail: Bring or upload your documents for professional laminating. No design setup needed.

color-bw-printing.title: Color & B&W printing
color-bw-printing.description: Documents, brochures, flyers, and posters — in color or black and white.
color-bw-printing.detail: Standard printing service for documents and marketing materials. Upload files at checkout.

plastification.title: Plastification
plastification.description: Long-lasting protection of your materials with quality plastification.
plastification.detail: Protect menus, posters, and documents with durable plastification.

t-shirt-printing.title: T-shirt printing
t-shirt-printing.description: Custom t-shirt printing — perfect for events, promotions, and gifts.
t-shirt-printing.detail: Choose a t-shirt, customize with your design, or use one of our pre-made layouts.

cup-printing.title: Cup printing
cup-printing.description: Personalized cups and mugs — great for promo or gifts.
cup-printing.detail: Select a mug or cup and personalize it with your logo or message.

bag-printing.title: Bag printing
bag-printing.description: Branded bags for your business or event.
bag-printing.detail: Pick a bag style and add your branding through our product customizer.

bookbinding.title: Bookbinding
bookbinding.description: Professional binding of documents, theses, catalogs, and books.
bookbinding.detail: Professional binding for theses, catalogs, and documents. Order directly — no design step.

wedding-invitations.title: Wedding invitations
wedding-invitations.description: Elegant invitations for your special day — with personalized design.
wedding-invitations.detail: Select a wedding invitation template and provide your event details.

birthday-invitations.title: Birthday invitations
birthday-invitations.description: Creative birthday invitations — for kids and adults.
birthday-invitations.detail: Choose a birthday design and send us the party details to personalize.

gift-sets.title: Personalized gift sets
gift-sets.description: Complete gift sets with your brand or message.
gift-sets.detail: Browse gift set products and customize them for your occasion.

designs.title: Designs
designs.subtitle: Choose a ready-made design and send your details, or personalize a template online with live preview.
designs.fixedSectionDesc: Fixed layouts — enter your details and we prepare the final design for printing.
designs.customizableSectionDesc: Edit text and colors on the preview, then order exactly what you see.
designs.menuGalleryNote: The listed price covers front and back cover customization only. Menu interior pages, food photos, and other extras are not included — our team will contact you after ordering to arrange those separately.

customize.pageSubtitle: Use the step-by-step editor to personalize front and back, then order exactly what you see.
customize.formSubtitle: Change text and colors to match your event or brand.
customize.previewNote: Live preview — your order includes front and back as shown.
customize.menuInsideNote: The price shown is for the front and back cover only. It does not include the interior menu pages, food photos, extra sections, or other add-ons. After you place your order, our team will contact you to collect your dishes, prices, and any photos, then prepare a quote for the inside pages.
customize.menuPriceNote: Price is for front & back cover only — not interior pages, photos, or extras.

front.title: Front side
front.desc: These fields appear on the front of your design.

back.title: Back side
back.desc: Contact info, RSVP, or additional text for the back.

colors.title: Colors
colors.desc: Pick a preset or fine-tune each color. Both sides update instantly.

review.title: Review & order
review.desc: Review both sides, set quantity, and add to your cart.

order.pageSubtitle: Enter your information below. We will apply it to this design and prepare your order.
order.fixedBadge: Ready-made design — layout is fixed; only your details change.
order.formSubtitle: Fill in the fields you need on your design. Only required fields are marked.
order.previewNote: Preview of the selected design. Your details will be placed by our team.
order.studioHint: Open the full design studio to add text, images, and fine-tune the layout.

studio.title: Design studio
studio.subtitle: Create your design — add text, images, and save it for ordering.
studio.canvasPreview: Preview your design using the chosen dimensions.
studio.uploadHint: We accept JPG, PNG, and PDF (max 10MB)
studio.savedDesignsHint: Your saved designs are stored on this device. Continue editing or add one to your cart.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Browse ready-made products or customize t-shirts, cups, bags, and more.

detail.premadeDesignsHint: Pick a design and order it as-is, or customize it further.
detail.imageDesignsHint: Full designs on the product — add text or a photo on top.
detail.textDesignsHint: Macedonian phrases with a spot for your photo — edit the text and upload a picture.

customizer.resizeHint: Drag to move, use corner handles to resize

about.title: About Print 8
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for professional printing.
about.story: Print 8 is a company dedicated to high-quality printing and personalized products. With modern equipment and experience, we turn your ideas into reality — from simple business cards to complex gift sets.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, quality printing services with a focus on customer satisfaction and fast delivery.
about.qualityDesc: Every project gets our full attention.
about.trustDesc: Pay on delivery — no risk for you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Get in touch — we'll respond as soon as possible.
contact.name: Full name

payment.a: We work exclusively with payment on delivery. You order online and pay when you receive the product.

formats.q: What file formats do you accept?
formats.a: We accept PDF, JPG, and PNG. For best results, use at least 300 DPI.

delivery.a: Standard delivery is 3–5 business days. For urgent orders, contact us.

custom.q: Can I create my own design?
custom.a: Yes! Use our design studio or upload your file when ordering.

minimum.a: It depends on the service. Business cards minimum is 100 pieces, t-shirts — 1 piece.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: Fill in your details. Payment is made on delivery.
checkout.emailHint: We'll send your order confirmation and design preview to this address.
checkout.codDesc: Pay for your products when they arrive.
checkout.uploadHint: Upload your designs (JPG, PNG, PDF — max 10MB)

orderSuccess.title: Order received!
orderSuccess.subtitle: Thank you. We'll contact you soon to confirm.
orderSuccess.confirmationEmail: A confirmation email with your design preview has been sent to your inbox.
